== Service claim needs a source ==
The article calls this person a Decipherian (a Decipher staff member) based on the fan anagram list, but the page has no inline citation, and no source found so far gives a Decipher role or dates. Under the Service-table rule (Bill, 2026-10-14), service mentioned on a person page must be a cited row in its == Service == table. The article was left unchanged; please add a source (and then a Service row), or remove the claim.
